# Laya-CoreML

**Open-weight typed decisions on Apple Silicon: Core ML, Neural Engine, zero generated tokens.**

[中文](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [Usage reference](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md) · [Benchmarks](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/blob/main/docs/ANE_BENCHMARKS.md) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/laya-coreml/) · [Hugging Face weights](https://huggingface.co/aac6fef/laya-multilingual-coreml-adaptive-fp16) · [Changelog](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Laya answers constrained questions (pick an option, score against a rubric, judge true or
false) with calibrated probabilities from one bidirectional forward pass. It generates no tokens
and returns no JSON to parse. This package runs the original [Laya](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya)
weights as Core ML programs on the CPU, GPU or Neural Engine. Inference needs no PyTorch,
Transformers or MLX.

**4.98 ms** median for one short multilingual decision on the M3 Max Neural Engine, using
**2.78× less system energy** than compiled MLX.

![Laya Core ML playing Snake with real local model probabilities](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/main/docs/assets/snake-demo.gif)

## Quick start

Requires Apple Silicon, macOS 15+ and Python 3.11–3.13.

```bash
pip install laya-coreml
```

```python
import laya_coreml as laya

agent = laya.load("aac6fef/laya-multilingual-coreml-adaptive-fp16")
result = agent.predict(
    "I was billed twice. Please refund the duplicate.",
    {
        "department": {
            "type": "choice",
            "instructions": "Which department should handle this request?",
            "criteria": {
                "billing": "Payments, invoices, refunds, and duplicate charges.",
                "technical": "Broken features, errors, and product troubleshooting.",
                "sales": "Pricing, upgrades, and new purchases.",
            },
        },
        "refund": {
            "type": "noul",
            "instructions": "Does the customer ask for money back?",
        },
    },
)
print(result["answers"]["department"]["choice"])  # billing
```

Describing each option, as above, works much better than bare labels. The bundle downloads
before first use; predictions after that are local. Pass
`local_files_only=True` to forbid network access.

## Question types

| Type | You provide | You get |
|---|---|---|
| `choice` | Named options, as a list or a label → description dict | Probability per option |
| `score` | Ordered rubric levels | Probability per level and the expected level |
| `noul` | A yes/no proposition | P(true) |

States can be text, JSON-like dicts or conversation lists. Each answer carries calibrated
probabilities and confidence fields; confidence does not guarantee accuracy on a new task.

## Model bundles

All bundles are under [`aac6fef/`](https://huggingface.co/aac6fef) on Hugging Face.

| Bundle | Engine | Capacity | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `laya-multilingual-coreml-adaptive-fp16` (also `-fp32`) | CPU + GPU | 1,024 tokens, native batch 1/2/4/16 | **Recommended** general multilingual model |
| `laya-coreml-adaptive-fp16` / `-fp32` | CPU + GPU | 512 tokens, native batch 1/2/4/16 | English, 421M |
| `laya-typed-decisions-coreml-adaptive-fp16` / `-fp32` | CPU + GPU | 1,024 tokens, native batch 1/2/4/16 | Upstream typed-decisions workflows |
| `laya-coreml`, `laya-multilingual-coreml`, `laya-typed-decisions-coreml` | CPU + GPU | 512 / 1,024 tokens, batch 1 | Original single-graph bundles; `Router()` defaults |
| `laya-multilingual-coreml-ane` | CPU + Neural Engine | 96 tokens total, batch 1 | Fastest short decisions, FP16 |
| `laya-multilingual-coreml-ane-w8` | CPU + Neural Engine | 96 tokens total, batch 1 | Approximate 8-bit palette weights |
| `laya-multilingual-coreml-snake` | CPU + GPU | 64 tokens, batch 3 | The Snake demo's three questions |

The ANE bundles' 96-token limit covers question, options and state together. Longer state is
truncated, while oversized questions or option sets raise. Every bundle includes its tokenizer,
model card, provenance, checksums and validation results.
[Choosing a bundle, pinned revisions and offline use](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#select-a-model).

## What else it does

All of these are covered in the [usage reference](https://github.com/mizorewww/laya-coreml/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md):

- **Language routing:** `Router()` detects the language, picks a bundle and keeps up to two resident. You can register your own bundles.
- **Batches and long documents:** `predict_batch` and `predict_long`, with answer attribution across windows.
- **Confidence gate:** `min_confidence=` marks low-confidence answers for review without changing them.
- **Large choice sets:** `predict_tournament` (no embedder) or `predict_shortlist` with your own embedding function.
- **Compute units:** `compute_units="cpu_gpu" | "c

# DeepOpen **English** | [简体中文](readme-cn.md)

**An intent-classification framework and non-autoregressive SDK for structured decisions.** DeepOpen evaluates predefined questions over text or JSON and returns labels, scores, and probabilities. It does not generate free-form text. Output types are constrained; predictions can still be wrong, and probabilities require validation on your own data. DeepOpen combines a decision SDK, dataset-specific training strategies, and reproducible Banking77 and CLINC150 evaluations. See [Resources and attribution](#resources-and-attribution) for the upstream foundations and this repository's contributions. ## Benchmark highlights | Dataset | DeepOpen test accuracy | Configuration | Correct / total | |---|---:|---|---:| | **BANKING77** | **94.1234%** | Single classifier, SAM seed 13 | 2,899 / 3,080 | | **CLINC150** | **98.0222%** | Four-encoder ensemble | 4,411 / 4,500 | [Explore both benchmark comparisons, predictions, and evaluation evidence on Hugging Face](https://c41-laya-evaluation.static.hf.space/index.html?version=ensemble-2#comparison). ### BANKING77 [![BANKING77 benchmark comparison: DeepOpen SAM 94.1234%, alongside selected published reference results](assets/banking77-hf-comparison.png)](https://c41-laya-evaluation.static.hf.space/index.html?version=ensemble-2#comparison) ### CLINC150 [![CLINC150 benchmark comparison: DeepOpen ensemble 98.0222%, alongside selected published reference results](assets/clinc150-hf-comparison.png)](https://c41-laya-evaluation.static.hf.space/index.html?version=ensemble-2#comparison) These screenshots show the selected references in the [HF evaluation page](https://c41-laya-evaluation.static.hf.space/index.html?version=ensemble-2#comparison) (reference snapshot: 7 October 2026); they do not assign an official leaderboard rank. BANKING77 displays the best test result of three SAM seeds, selected after evaluation; the three-seed mean is **94.0368%**, with no statistically established improvement over the replayed baseline. CLINC150 covers **150 in-scope intents only**, without OOS detection, and combines one Laya-based specialist with three DeBERTa-v3-large models. Full protocol, execution caveats, and prediction files are available on the linked page. ## Installation Use Python **3.10 or newer** and Git. Install from this repository; the installation instructions do not depend on a PyPI release named `deepopen`. ```bash python -m pip install "git+https://github.com/deepopen-com/deepopen.git" python -c "import deepopen; print(deepopen.__version__)" ``` For a CPU-only environment, install CPU PyTorch before the SDK: ```bash python -m pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu python -m pip install "git+https://github.com/deepopen-com/deepopen.git" ``` GPU users should install a PyTorch build compatible with their driver and CUDA environment. The benchmark training scripts have separate dependencies and instructions in their respective directories. ## Quick start This example loads the English upstream checkpoint and answers one classification question. The first call downloads weights and initializes the model; it is not a warm-inference latency measurement. ```python import deepopen agent = deepopen.load("convaiinnovations/laya", device="cpu") questions = { "department": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which department should handle this request?", "criteria": { "billing": "invoices, payments, refunds", "technical": "bugs, outages, system errors", "sales": "pricing, new contracts", "other": "everything else", }, } } result = agent.predict( {"body": "I was charged twice. # AirCard-iOS

Apple Wallet card skins, lock screen passcode themes, and PosterBoard wallpapers directly on iOS (18.0 – 27.2 beta 2).

## Overview AirCard-iOS customizes Apple Wallet card artwork, lock screen passcode dialers, and lock screen wallpapers on device without a jailbreak. The app communicates with internal system services over a local loopback tunnel (`10.7.0.1` or `127.0.0.1`) provided by LocalDevVPN. File operations are handled by `AirliftFFI`, a Rust library that interfaces with the AirTraffic service. ## Compatibility | iOS Version | Status | Pairing Method | Features Supported | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **iOS 27.0 – 27.0.1** | ✅ Supported | On-device Settings or imported pairing file | Wallet skins, Passcode themes, Tendies wallpapers | | **iOS 27.2 beta 1 – beta 2** | ✅ Supported | On-device Settings or imported pairing file | Tested and working | | **iOS 18.0 – 26.x** | ✅ Supported | Imported pairing file only | Wallet skins & Passcode themes (via SideStore / LiveContainer / AltStore pairing file) | | **iOS 27.2 beta 3+** | ❌ Patched | None | Apple patched the underlying `airlift` exploit. Does not work. | > [!IMPORTANT] > **Do not update past iOS 27.2 beta 2:** Apple patched the AirTraffic sync exploit in iOS 27.2 beta 3. If you update past beta 2, file injection will no longer work. ## Features ### Apple Wallet card skins - Writes custom card artwork to Passbook caches (`cardBackgroundCombined@3x.png`, `@2x.png`, and `cardBackgroundCombined.pdf` for transit cards like Suica). - Flushes front-face and thumbnail caches so new artwork appears immediately when Wallet opens. - Detects card identifiers in real time when you bring up Apple Pay. - Apply artwork to individual cards or batch-flash every detected card. ### Passcode dialer themes - Live dialer preview with touch panning and zoom framing. - Full poster layout across all ten buttons, or individual circular button cutouts. - Targets system dialer caches (`TelephonyUI-10`). - Localized number subtext options, including Ukrainian and Russian Cyrillic layouts. - Import and export themes as `.passthm` files. ### PosterBoard wallpapers (.tendies) - Import and unpack `.tendies` wallpaper archives directly from the Files app. - Auto-detects PosterBoard wallpaper containers and active descriptor UUIDs. - Injects wallpaper configurations and assets into PosterBoard storage. - Automatically triggers a NeoSpring respring after flashing to apply wallpapers without rebooting your iPhone. ### Pairing options - **Import pairing file**: Supports pairing files (`.mobiledevicepairing`, `.plist`, `.mobilepair`) from **SideStore**, **LiveContainer**, **iLoader**, **AltStore**, **Jitterbug**, or exported from Mac/PC. - **On-device pairing (iOS 27+)**: Advertises locally over Bonjour so the phone can pair with itself via Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode > Pair with AirCard-iOS. - **Safe unpairing**: Easily delete the active pairing file to re-pair or switch pairing credentials at any time. ## Prerequisites 1. **iOS 18.0 – 27.2 beta 2** (iOS 27.0+ for on-device Settings pairing, or imported pairing file on iOS 18–26). Note: iOS 27.2 beta 3+ is patched. 2. **LocalDevVPN / WireGuard**: Running in loopback mode (`10.7.0.1` or `127.0.0.1`) so local connections can reach internal device services. 3. **Pairing record**: Either on-device pairing or an imported pairing file. ## Pairing Setup Guide AirCard-iOS requires a pairing record to communicate with device lockdown services. Choose the method that best matches your setup: ### Option A: SideStore (Recommended) If you already use SideStore on your device, it has already created a valid pairing file: 1. Open **AirCard-iOS** and go to the **Pairing** tab. 2. Tap **Import Pairing File…**. 3. In the Files document picker, navigate to: ```text On My iPhone › SideStore › ALTPairingFile.mobiledevicepairing ``` 4. Select `ALTPairingFile.mobiledevicepairing`. The app will load it immediately (`Pairing file loaded ✅`). ### Option B: LiveContainer (with SideStore inside) If you run SideStore inside

overview: В этой подборке представлены четыре проекта с разными целями. Репозиторий mizorewww/laya-coreml описывает локальные типизированные решения на Apple Core ML и Neural Engine, позволяющие выполнять быстрые решения за несколько миллисекунд на процессорах M3 Max. Репозиторий deepopen-com/deepopen предлагает неавторегрессионный движок System 1 для структурированных типовых задач, выдающий метки, оценки и вероятности без генерации свободного текста. Репозиторий pallavi-shekhar/ai-engineering-interview-questions-company-wise собирает вопросы и ответы для интервью по инженерии ИИ в 35 компаниях. Репозиторий Mak5er/AirCard-iOS предоставляет набор тем и скинов для Apple Wallet и экранов блокировки iOS 27 без необходимости джейлбрейка.
